{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Go

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  complete:
    if: always()
    needs: [check, build, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
    - if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')
      run: exit 1

  check:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-22.04]
        go: ["1.25"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        # For pull requests, build and test the PR head not a merge of the PR with the destination.
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.ref }}
    - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ matrix.go }}-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
    - run: ./gomod.sh
    - run: ./gofmt.sh
    - run: ./gogenerate.sh
    - run: ./govet.sh
    - run: ./staticcheck.sh

  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-22.04]
        go: ["1.25", "1.26"]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        # For pull requests, build and test the PR head not a merge of the PR with the destination.
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.ref }}
    - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ matrix.go }}-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
    - run: go build ./...
    - name: Build binaries
      run: go run ./support/scripts/build_release_artifacts/main.go

  test:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-22.04]
        go: ["1.25", "1.26"]
        pg: [12, 16]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:${{ matrix.pg }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
        - 5432:5432
      redis:
        image: redis
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
        ports:
        - 6379:6379
    env:
      PGHOST: localhost
      PGPORT: 5432
      PGUSER: postgres
      PGPASSWORD: postgres
      PGDATABASE: postgres
      REDIS_HOST: localhost
      REDIS_PORT: 6379
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        # For pull requests, build and test the PR head not a merge of the PR with the destination.
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.ref }}
        # We need to full history for git-restore-mtime to know what modification dates to use.
        # Otherwise, the Go test cache will fail (due to the modification time of fixtures changing).
        fetch-depth: '0'
    - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-go
      with:
        go-version: ${{ matrix.go }}
    - name: Cache Go modules
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/go/pkg/mod
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ matrix.go }}-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
    - run: go test -race -cover -timeout=20m ./...
",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads Go dependencies in each job (check, build, test) without caching. Evidence from experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 shows that caching Go modules (~/go/pkg/mod) with a key based on runner OS, Go version, and hash of go.mod/go.sum reduces median elapsed time by ~6%. The same pattern is supported by experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200 for Gradle. The repository has go.mod and go.sum lockfiles, satisfying the precondition that cache inputs include lockfile and environment. Adding a cache step after setting up Go and before any Go command that downloads dependencies preserves all build and test coverage while reducing redundant network transfers and disk I/O.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
